title: Dars 1: Present Simple & Kundalik Tartib
description: Ushbu darsda odatiy va takrorlanuvchi harakatlar (Daily routines) haqida gapirishni o'rganamiz. Qoida: He/She/It olmoshlariga fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi.
grammar_rules:
• I/You/We/They + verb (I wake up at 7 AM)
• He/She/It + verb-s/es (He plays tennis)
• Inkor: don't / doesn't + verb
• So'roq: Do / Does + ega + verb?

quiz.question: My brother _____ up at 6:30 every morning.
quiz.explanation: 'My brother' (he) bo'lgani uchun fe'lga '-s' qo'shiladi: 'wakes up'.

quiz.question: We _____ watch TV late at night.
quiz.explanation: 'We' olmoshi uchun Present Simple inkorida 'don't' ishlatiladi.

quiz.question: _____ your sister work in a bank?
quiz.explanation: 'Your sister' (she) uchun so'roq gapda 'Does' yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

writing_task.prompt: Write 3-5 sentences about your daily routine. (Kundalik tartibingiz haqida 3-5 ta jumla yozing. Masalan: Qachon uyg'onasiz, nima qilasiz va qachon uxlaysiz).
writing_task.sample_answer: I usually wake up at 7:00 in the morning. I wash my face and eat breakfast with my family. Then I go to work by bus. In the evening, I study English and read books before going to bed.

title: Dars 2: Past Simple & Unutilmas Xotiralar
description: O'tib ketgan aniq vaqtdagi voqea-hodisalar haqida so'zlash. To'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi, noto'g'ri fe'llar esa 2-shaklga (V2) o'zgaradi.
grammar_rules:
• Tasdiq: Subject + V2 (I bought a laptop yesterday)
• Inkor: Subject + didn't + V1
• So'roq: Did + subject + V1?
• Kalit so'zlar: yesterday, last week, 2 days ago, in 2020

quiz.question: Last weekend, we _____ a fantastic movie at the cinema.
She didn't _____ to the party because she felt sick.
quiz.explanation: 'Didn't' inkor yordamchi fe'lidan keyin asosiy fe'l o'zining boshlang'ich (V1) shaklida keladi: 'didn't go'.

quiz.question: Where _____ you spend your last summer vacation?
quiz.explanation: O'tgan zamondagi maxsus so'roq gaplarida yordamchi fe'l 'did' bo'ladi.

writing_task.prompt: Describe what you did last weekend. (O'tgan dam olish kunlarida nimalar qilganingizni Past Simple zamonida 3-5 gapda bayon qiling).
writing_task.sample_answer: Last Saturday, I visited my grandparents in the countryside. We had a wonderful dinner together and talked about old times. On Sunday, I watched an exciting football match with my friends.

title: Dars 3: Present Perfect & Shaxsiy Tajribalar
description: Hozirgi paytgacha bo'lgan natija yoki hayotiy tajribalar (Life experiences) haqida so'zlash. Qolip: have/has + V3 (Past Participle).
grammar_rules:
• I/You/We/They + have + V3
• He/She/It + has + V3
• Signal so'zlar: already, yet, just, ever, never, since, for

quiz.question: I have lived in this city _____ five years.
quiz.explanation: Vaqt davomiyligi (muddat) bilan 'for' ishlatiladi ('for five years').

quiz.question: Have you ever _____ an English novel from start to finish?
He has _____ finished his project, so he can relax now.
quiz.explanation: Tasdiq gaplarda allaqachon bajarilgan ish uchun 'already' qo'llaniladi.

writing_task.prompt: Share 2-3 of your greatest achievements or unique experiences using Present Perfect. (O'zingiz erishgan yutuqlar yoki qiziqarli tajribalaringiz haqida 'have/has + V3' qolipidan foydalanib yozing).
writing_task.sample_answer: I have learned a lot of English vocabulary over the past six months. I have also visited three different foreign countries with my colleagues, which has opened my mind to new cultures.
